visualCharacteristics.notes: heading with prev/next arrows in the header row, flyer image beside stacked icon/lavender CTA buttons (WhatsApp, download); arrows mirror in RTL; arrows hidden with a single slide

contentPattern: Carousel (2 columns per row): cell 1 = flyer image; cell 2 = CTA links (e.g. 'Get Weekly Deals on WhatsApp' -> https://wa.me/..., 'Download Promotions Now!' -> promotion PDF). WhatsApp/download icons are applied by CSS based on the link URL. One row per promotion.
